name: pi-scope-agent-extensions
_doc: npm dependencies of the extensions in this directory — pi's own convention
for a local extension is "put npm dependencies in a nearby package.json"
(see pi's docs/extensions.md), and this is the one they share.
Nothing here runs a package manager by itself. Pi Scope's installer
every extension pi has available and installs the missing ones into the
bundled pi project (~/.pi-scope/pi), whose node_modules the app, the agent
and every extension share — no per-extension node_modules anywhere.
typebox) out of "dependencies": pi maps those itself.
browser.ts resolves its packages from PI_BROWSER_MODULE_ROOT (which Pi Scope
pins to the bundled pi project), then the process cwd, then $HOME.
